description: Teaching model of IFRS 17 (K-IFRS 1117) general measurement: present value of premiums (start of year) vs claims and expenses (end of year) plus acquisition cost and a risk adjustment (% of outflow PV) → fulfilment cash flows, initial contractual service margin (CSM) or loss component, and the yearly CSM release with interest accretion and equal coverage units. Illustration only, not reserve certification.

ra.description: Risk adjustment as a fraction of the outflow PV, e.g. 0.05

rate.description: Discount rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.03
